transcript.answer: I found no p99 latency SLO defined for the /api/context route. Its spec (specs/api-routes/context/spec.md) has no latency target. It only notes that `assembleContext` may write a latency audit row. The only p99 figure I found is a platform-wide, aspirational target: context search should return in under 200ms (p99). That comes from the 1-lore-platform spec, where a 2026-03-28 note says p99 had not been benchmarked yet. It is not tied to /api/context specifically. Other latency thresholds in the retrieval-benchmarks spec are p95 (200ms for search, 500ms for lore_assemble_context), not p99.
